description: Na₃ScZnP₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.91 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-3.02 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.75 Å. Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.22 Å. Zn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted ZnO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.35 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-39°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-40°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.58 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-39°. There is one shorter (1.47 Å) and three longer (1.49 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Zn, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Zn, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Zn, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one Zn, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sc, and one S atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal bipyramidal geometry to three Na, one Sc, and one P atom.
